sections.question: By what percentage did EOG's total debt grow from the end of 2019 to June 30, 2026? Round to one decimal place.
sections.reasoning:
1. Doc 1 (March 16, 2020): at December 31, 2019 the net debt reconciliation shows "Current and Long-Term Debt (GAAP) - (b)" of 5,175 million; the release text rounds this total debt to "$5.2 billion".
2. Doc 7: the same line at June 30, 2026 is 7,926 million.
3. Doc 1 and Doc 7: (7,926 - 5,175) / 5,175 = 53.2% (to one decimal place).
Conclusion: total debt grew 53.2%.
